# A "listing" page builds itself: Quarto finds every project folder below
# and shows each one as a card. To add a project, copy a folder and edit it.
listing:

  type: grid
  grid-columns: 2
  sort: "date desc"
  categories: true
  fields: [image, years, title, description, categories]
  image-placeholder: ../images/card-placeholder.svg

Past, current and future work, newest first.
